text: Tanvi's moving to Leeds on 14 November, her partner got a job at the uni there. She sounded excited but knackered from packing.
graham - cat (Biscuit) back at the vets thurs, kidney thing again. he's really worried
Bao and his wife picked up their new puppy on Saturday, a little cockapoo called Miso. Kids are obsessed apparently.
Remind me to text Nasser on Friday to see how the flat viewing in Hackney went.
Colm's mum turns 80 on the 3rd of December. Big family lunch planned in Galway, he's flying over the Thursday before.
Milan says the house sale fell through so the move on 28/11 is off. Gutted. They're staying put till spring now.

so um Malik was saying his brother Hamza is starting at Edinburgh next September, doing medicine, and the whole family's thrilled, his dad's already booked the hotel for the drop off weekend. Malik himself is thinking about moving up there too, maybe next spring, if his work lets him go remote, and his girlfriend Yasmin is weirdly up for it, she's never even been to Scotland
Nia - vegan now, still at the hospital pharmacy, wants to get a rescue greyhound eventually
Need to drop the spare keys at the letting agent before 5 tomorrow. Also cancel the broadband at the old place.
Aarav got the flat in Bristol!! Signs the lease Monday, moves in on the 1st. Send him a housewarming card.
Haruto Tanaka's daughter has her first ballet recital next Saturday. He's more nervous than she is.
Javier mentioned his dog Rocco turns ten this weekend. They're doing a sausage cake lol
callum struggling a bit, new city, doesn't know anyone in Manchester yet. his gf stays down in Brighton till Jan. check in w him next week
Agnieszka and her husband are off to Kraków for her nan's 90th on 22 Oct, back the following Tuesday.
Kate said her son Ollie has his driving test on 9th Nov, third attempt. Don't forget to wish him luck that morning.
Uma - two cats, Pickle and Fig. Fig had a tooth out yesterday, eating fine now. Uma works from home Mon/Wed.

Coffee with Oisín. He and Giulia are viewing a two-bed in Clontarf this Saturday and another in Drumcondra on Sunday. If either comes off they'd move before Christmas. Giulia's pregnant, due in March, so they really need the extra room. He's stressed about the mortgage stuff but trying to stay chill. Ask him Monday how the viewings went.
Krisztina's dad has a hip op on 17/11. She's going home to Debrecen for a fortnight to help her mum out.
Must get Caitlin something for her birthday, it's the 2nd. She keeps going on about wanting a proper plant mister and a nice watering can for the new flat.
James - lives in Didsbury now, not Chorlton. works at the BBC, Salford. has a parrot called Captain, honestly

voice note: Yasmin rang, her sister Blessing just got engaged, wedding probably summer 2028. Yasmin's maid of honour and already panicking about the hen do, thinking Lisbon or maybe Dublin, sometime next spring. Blessing's fiancé is called Kwame, they met at uni, been together about six years. Their mum is over the moon
Chioma's starting her new job at the council on Monday. Moving to Leicester for it, flat's tiny but cheap.
Teresa's budgie died last night. She had him for twelve years. Send her a little card.
Hemi's back from Auckland on Wednesday after three weeks with his family. His grandad wasn't well but is apparently on the mend.
Meeting Chen for lunch on Thursday at 1. Bring the moving boxes she lent me.
Bruno and Abdi celebrating 5 years together on 30 Oct, booked somewhere fancy in Soho. Bruno hinted Abdi would love a record player.
Yosef said they're thinking of leaving London altogether, maybe Sheffield. His wife grew up there and her parents are getting older.
Graham's daughter Nia (not work Nia) graduates on 12th December, Durham. He's chuffed.
Book van for the move - Sat 7th or Sun 8th? Ring Big Yellow re storage. Meter readings on the day.
Tanvi's puppy Dosa had his jabs today, can finally go out for walks from next Friday.
Call Bao this weekend about whether he still needs help moving the piano on the 15th.

Malik rang, his mum's in hospital since Sunday, chest infection. Probably out by Friday if all goes well. His dad's not coping brilliantly on his own, doesn't really cook, so Malik's been driving over from Luton every night after work. He sounded shattered. I should drop round some food for them tomorrow evening, and maybe offer to do a hospital run at the weekend so he gets a break.
milan's cat Luna went missing tues night, still not back. they've put flyers up all over Kentish Town. poor guy's barely slept
Quick one, Aarav's partner Priya has an interview with Deloitte on Wednesday. Ask him how it went Thursday.
Nasser's son Zayd starts reception in September, they got their first choice school. Nasser's off work the first week to settle him in.
Bumped into Kate at the vets, her spaniel Bramble's having a lump removed on Tuesday the 4th. She's trying not to think about it.
Javier - from Valencia, moved here 2019, supports Valencia CF religiously, hates coriander. Into climbing.
Colm said the leaving do for his boss is next Friday, the 31st. He's organising the whip round, I'm chipping in a tenner.

OK so long recap from dinner with Krisztina and Callum. Krisztina got the promotion, she starts as team lead after Christmas, 5 Jan. Callum's finally found a place in Ancoats, moves on the 20th of November, and his girlfriend's joining him there in January. He's also adopting a kitten from his neighbour, a grey one called Smudge. Krisztina's cat Paprika has diabetes now and needs injections twice a day. Remind me to send Krisztina congrats properly and to text Callum the week after he moves to see how he's settling.
Uma's brother Dev is moving to Toronto in a fortnight. She's taking it pretty hard.
Haruto - his wife Mei is due 20/02. They're redoing the box room as a nursery this weekend.
Order Mum's flowers for Sunday. Pay rent. Dentist Tue 10am.
Hemi asked about the flat upstairs, says his cousin might want it from Dec. Need to email the landlord tomorrow and pass on Hemi's number.
Giulia's mum flies in from Bologna on the 6th and stays until the 20th. Giulia already dreading it a bit, the flat's half in boxes.
Agnieszka - teaches primary, Year 4, at St Mary's. allergic to cats which is awkward bc her boyfriend Tomasz has two

Teresa Reyes (Tess) said her grandson Leo's christening is on 16 Nov at St Anne's, and the party after at her daughter's place in Croydon. She's making the cake herself, wants to practise next weekend. Daughter and son-in-law moved there in the summer and still don't have curtains. I'm going to the service but not the do after.
Chen's hamster had babies?? Eight of them. She's trying to rehome them by mid-November.
Bruno's dad retires end of this month after 40 years at the docks. Party on Saturday the 1st, family only.
Yasmin's flat viewing tomorrow was cancelled, landlord let it to someone else. She's back to looking.
Don't forget Abdi's birthday on Thursday. He mentioned wanting the new Murakami.

Caitlin's partner Sean got made redundant last week. They might have to move back in with her parents in Derry in the new year. She's putting a brave face on it. Their lease is up on 31 Jan anyway. The kids don't know yet, and their dog Murphy would have to go to Sean's brother because her dad's allergic. Text her at the weekend just to check in.
Chioma's little brother Emeka has his GCSE mocks starting Monday. Her mum's stressing more than he is.
Dog sitting Rolo for James from Friday to Monday while he's in Lisbon. Need to pick up his food Thurs.
Followed up with Oisín. Viewings went well, they offered on the Clontarf one yesterday and it got accepted! Completion around 12th January. Giulia's scan on Friday was all fine too.
yosef: kids are Ari (7) and Noa (4). Noa's birthday is 3/12, she's into dinosaurs atm, anything with a T-rex

Nia rang, she's put an offer in on a house in Cardiff, finds out Friday or Monday. Her dog Bear will finally have a garden. She's convinced she won't get it. Her mum's offered to help with the deposit, which she's a bit funny about accepting. Asking price was 245 and she went in at 238. Ring her Monday either way.
Graham and his wife Sue off to Lanzarote next Tuesday for ten days, first holiday since the move. Their son's feeding the cat.
Tidy the spare room before Saturday. Return the drill.

Tanvi mentioned her sister-in-law Kavya just had twins, born Sunday morning, both healthy. Tanvi's going up to Birmingham on the 25th to meet them. Remind me to get a little something for the babies before Friday. Kavya's husband is apparently running on no sleep already and their older boy Arjun is not impressed about sharing his mum.
Mrs Ito next door says her cat Kuro is 18 tomorrow. Eighteen! She's having her niece round for tea to mark it.
